neighbours.label: function word (the / that / which) in the second, repeated-'of' half of a discipline definition: 'the study of X and of ⟦the⟧ Y ⟦that⟧ / by ⟦which⟧ they…'
fire: Chemistry is the study of substances and of the reactions that they undergo.
Ecology is the science of organisms and of the environments in which they live.
Economics is the study of goods and of the ways by which they are exchanged.
Linguistics is the study of languages and of the rules that govern them.
Astronomy is the science of stars and of the laws that shape their motion.
Sociology is the study of groups and of the customs by which they are bound.
Meteorology is the science of the air and of the changes that it undergoes.
Botany is the study of plants and of the conditions in which they grow.
quiet: Chemistry is the study of substances and their reactions.
Ecology is the science of organisms living in their environments.
Economics is the study of how goods are exchanged.
Linguistics is the study of languages and their rules.
Astronomy is the science of stars and their motion.
Sociology is the study of groups bound by customs.
Meteorology is the science of the changing air.
Botany is the study of plants and how they grow.
